'''Charnax Industries''' was an industrial facility located in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Charnax Industries appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
